hook_line: AIRLINES CUT DIWALI FLIGHTS FOR FIRST TIME SINCE COVID AS FARES SURGE

hook_stat.sub: Fewer flights scheduled across October and November than a year earlier, by Cirium data

stats.label: Weekly domestic flights scheduled for November, down 606 or 2.6%
Decline in domestic passenger traffic in September

diaspora_bullets: Recheck flight times before travelling, as schedules can still change
Expect fewer choices and higher fares on thinner routes
news_summary: Airlines scheduled about 6% fewer flights across October and November than a year earlier, according to Cirium data reported by Bloomberg, the first capacity decline since 2020, while festive fares on some routes surged.
payoff: On thinner routes, travellers may find fewer options and less fare competition.
